description: This file contains localization strings for the Select2 library version 4.0.6-rc.1, providing Chinese (zh-CN) translations for user interface messages.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message prompting user to delete excess characters when input is too long.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message prompting user to input more characters when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message when maximum number of selections is reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns message indicating a search is in progress.
